description: Video object: an external video URL plus provider metadata derived on save and an optional uploaded poster image

url.$comment: The video URL as pasted by the author, after trim. Source of truth.

provider.$comment: Provider detected from the URL. Derived on save; empty before the save pipeline first resolves it (Task 4).

videoId.$comment: Provider-specific video id. Derived on save.

thumbnail.$comment: Vendor thumbnail URL, or empty when unavailable. Derived on save.

title.$comment: Video title from oEmbed when the provider returns one, else empty. Derived on save.

aspectRatio.$comment: W:H aspect ratio derived from oEmbed, else 16:9. Derived on save.

poster.$comment: Optional uploaded poster image, same shape as an image property
